title: fix(metadata, metadata-protocol, core)!: the bare read and removal of an action name judge the loaders' slots beside the registry's, tell the platform's package-less item from the environment's, and remove what the bare read answers (ADR-0150 D3)
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-bill"} -->
_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg4LiuMvJwdwouoheGbF45op)_
epic:#31527#2 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CXsZN7qMreCTYFeT5Y

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：不带包名按名读取或删除动作时，进程内现在把 loader 里存着的同名项也算上；只在内存注册、没有存储的无包动作算"平台的"，和包的动作并存时返回 409。
- 新堵住一个缝：一个包在内存、另一个包只在 loader 时，以前会悄悄挑内存里那个，现在 409 点名两个包。
- 元数据服务里有环境项、旁边有一个停用包时，按名读取现在先答环境项（有环境行）或 409 点名包和平台（无环境行），以前答启用包的动作。
- 按名删除（不带包名）在一个包加一个环境项时只删环境项，和按名读答哪个一致；以前把包的动作也一起删了。拒绝文案里有非包候选时写 "holders"。
- 风险与回滚：第一方组合里没有和包内动作同名的无包动作，本仓库所有应答不变；代价是裸读命中内存包槽时多读一次 loader。回滚即 revert 本 PR。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/metadata exec vitest run src/metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts -t 32560`，预期 15 例全过（基线上 11 例红）。

Fixes #32560

Clause-②: yes (narrowing) — narrowing: `MetadataManager.get('action', NAME)` / `getDiagnosed` of a name a package holds in memory goes from 200 to 409 where a second package holds it only in a loader (it answered the in-memory package's item, a pick between two packages), and where a package-less item no loader stores (the platform's) stands beside the package (it answered the platform's item); the served `GET /meta/action/NAME` and its `/layers` follow where the metadata service's answer reaches them; `MetadataManager.unregister('action', NAME)` beside the platform's item and a package goes from removing both to the same 409. Moved answers (same status, the rule's holder in place of another): the in-process bare read beside one package answers the environment's own item a loader stores (it answered the package's); the served bare read answers the environment's item the metadata service holds beside a disabled package (it answered the enabled package's), and the enabled holder's item where the service holds only a disabled package's customization (it answered that customization); a removal naming no package beside one package removes the environment's own item only (it removed the package's action too). Refusals naming a non-package candidate count "holders".
Metadata-protocol: none — no key, value or metadata type an author writes changes; what moves is which holder a by-name read or removal naming no package answers or takes, and when it refuses.
Skills-docs: none — `skills/**` and `content/docs/**` teach no bare read or removal of an action name a package-less item shares with a package; the prescription ships in the refusal text and the FROM → TO below.

## What changes

Step 0 measured each item on #32551's head merged with `main` (#32533 included); seat ruling 6817582700 took every one. Row 6 was added from #32551's third contract review. This branch is `main` 9cd5fc161 (both #32551 and #32507 included) plus this card.

| # | state (no package named) | call | FROM | TO | arm |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| 1 | A on `account` in memory + package-less on `contact` registered only (no loader stores it) | `MetadataManager.get` / `getDiagnosed` | 200 package-less item | 409 `[A, platform]` + "The platform's item binds it to object "contact"" | narrowing |
| 1 | same, in the metadata service, no environment row | `GET /meta/action/NAME`, `/layers` | 200 package-less item | 409 `[A, platform]` | narrowing |
| 2 | A in memory + the environment's item only in a loader | `MetadataManager.get` / `getDiagnosed` | 200 A | 200 environment's | moved answer |
| 2' | A in memory + B only in a loader | `MetadataManager.get` / `getDiagnosed` | 200 A (a pick) | 409 `[A, B]` | narrowing |
| 3 | service: A, disabled B, environment on `lead`; registry: A; environment row present | `GET /meta/action/NAME`, `/layers` code layer | 200 A | 200 environment's | moved answer |
| 3 | same, no environment row | same | 200 A | 409 `[A, platform]` | narrowing |
| 6 | service: the disabled B's slot holds a package-less body (B's customization), no slot of the enabled A; registry: A, disabled B | `GET /meta/action/NAME`, `/layers` code layer | 200 B's customization | 200 A's | moved answer |
| 4 | A, B + environment | every refusal | "held by 3 packages" | "held by 3 holders" | wording |
| 5a | A, B + environment | `MetadataManager.unregister` (no package) | 409 `[A, B]` | 409 `[A, B, environment]` + its sentence | refusal names every candidate |
| 5b | A + environment on another object or object-less | `MetadataManager.unregister` (no package), `MemoryLoader` / `DatabaseLoader.delete` | removes both | removes the environment's only (slot, door copy, package-less rows) | moved answer |
| 5b | A + platform item (registered only) | `MetadataManager.unregister` (no package) | removes both | 409 `[A, platform]`, nothing removed | narrowing |

**The fix.**

1. **Registry ∪ loaders (`package-slotted-store.ts`, `metadata-manager.ts`).** `judgesLoaderSlots` says when a read naming no package of an action name must look past the registry: the registry holds a package's slot of the name. `get` and `getDiagnosed` then read the loaders' slots of the name and judge the registry's and the loaders' slots together (`slotViewOf`, which now inherits the registry's write order, so "written last" is unchanged). **Cost:** one `loaderSlotsNamed` per bare action read that hits a package's slot in memory (`DatabaseLoader.loadSlots` reads the type's rows); every other read is unchanged.
2. **Platform vs environment in process.** `platformSlotsOf` calls a package-less registry slot the platform's when no loader stores it on that key (object and name). `readStoreEntry`, `refuseAcrossOwners` and `readIdentity` take those keys: the platform's item beside any package is refused naming `{ kind: 'platform' }`; the environment's answers first beside one package, as before. With a loader failing, no slot is called the platform's (the old reading).
3. **Removal (`storeRemovalKeys`).** Beside one package a removal naming none takes the action name's package-less slots only; the platform's beside a package is refused; beside two packages the refusal names the package-less holder too. The manager judges this over the registry ∪ loaders view; `MemoryLoader` and `DatabaseLoader` apply the same rule to their own slots and rows.
4. **The service's dropped refusal (`protocol-meta-item-reads.ts`, served face).** `rethrowPackageScopedRefusal` now hands back the refusal it drops (fewer than two enabled packages). `judgeDroppedServiceRefusal` judges the package-less item that refusal names, read from the service's list: alone it answers; beside one enabled package it answers when the environment's store holds an active package-less row of it on the same object, and is refused naming the package and the platform otherwise. The plain read's served face and the layered read's code layer use it.
5. **A disabled package's customization (`servedFromDisabledHolder`).** Added from #32551's third review: a package-less service answer fits a judged package holder only when it is not a disabled holder's: the service, asked at each disabled holder the registry names, does not answer the same item. Only read when the judged answer is set and the service's answer is package-less.
6. **Wording (`@objectstack/core`).** `packageScopedRefusalMessage` counts "holders" whenever a candidate is not a package.

## Tests

- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-action-slots.test.ts`, `[#32560]` (11): items 1, 2, 2', 4, 5a, 5b (two shapes, and the platform), CONTROL environment stored beside A, CONTROL platform alone / one package alone, CONTROL one package on two objects answers the one written last over the loaders.
- `packages/metadata/src/metadata-manager-match-endpoint.test.ts`, `[#32560]` (4): with `DatabaseLoader` rows, 5b in two shapes (slot and row of the environment only), 5a refusal with rows untouched, CONTROL one package.
- `packages/runtime/src/action-package-addressing.test.ts` (over a real `MetadataManager`): item 3 with and without the environment row, item 1 through the protocol, CONTROL disabled package and the environment alone. The `[#32365]` pins that register "the environment's item" now store it in the service's loader too (an item only registered is the platform's).
- Runtime also pins row 6: the disabled B's customization in the service, no A slot → A's on both reads.
- Red on the base: metadata 11 of 15 red (the 4 CONTROLs green); runtime 3 of 4 red (the CONTROL green); row 6 red with its check removed (it is absent on the base).
- Ablation: `loadSlottedDiagnosed` passing no platform keys → item 1 red (1 failed); `servedFromDisabledHolder` short-circuited → row 6 red (1 failed); both restored → green.

## Acceptance notes

- One package alone, the environment's item alone, the platform's item alone, and every read or removal naming a package answer as before.
- No first-party composition has a package-less action under a package's action name, so no answer changes in this repository.
- `DatabaseLoader` keeps one row per `(package, name)`; a package-less action written through `register` beside one package's becomes its customization (D4), so the environment-beside-package row shape is pinned by inserting the row directly.
